subject: Basic Electronics

questions.markdown: An n-channel MOSFET has $\mu_n C_{ox} = 0.5\ \mathrm{mA/V^2}$, $W/L = 5/0.18$ and $V_{th} = 0.5\ \mathrm{V}$. Determine the value of $V_{GS}$ required to get $10\ \mathrm{mA}$ saturated drain current. Also explain pinch-off state of operation in n-channel enhancement MOSFET.

A germanium diode passes $10\ \mathrm{mA}$ current when forward biased with $0.4\ \mathrm{V}$ at $27^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Determine the reverse saturation current. If the temperature rises to $37^\circ\mathrm{C}$, determine the forward current, static resistance and dynamic resistance.
Determine the voltage for which the reverse current in a Ge diode reaches $60\%$ of its reverse saturation value at room temperature. Given $\eta = 1$.

A half wave rectifier is fed from a transformer having turns ratio $6:1$. The primary voltage is $110\ \mathrm{V}$ at $60\ \mathrm{Hz}$. It is decided to have ripple factor less than $0.03$ and dc load current of $500\ \mathrm{mA}$. Find the value of capacitor needed.

In a Zener regulator, $R_S = 120\ \Omega$, $R_L = 250\ \Omega$ and $V_Z = 5\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the minimum and maximum current flowing through Zener diode when input varies from $9\ \mathrm{V}$ to $15\ \mathrm{V}$.
With neat sketches, explain the channel-length modulation effect in MOSFET.

Design the square wave generator using OPAMP for the following specifications. Frequency of oscillation = $1\ \mathrm{kHz}$, $V_o(p-p) = 16.4\ \mathrm{V}$. Assume $\beta = 0.5$. Explain the operation with neat circuit diagram and relevant waveforms.

Define and calculate the CMRR for an OPAMP, when $V_1$ is $0.25\ \mathrm{mV}$ and $V_2$ is $-0.25\ \mathrm{mV}$, output voltage is $4\ \mathrm{V}$. For the same op-amp, when $V_1 = V_2 = 0.5\ \mathrm{mV}$, output voltage is $6\ \mathrm{mV}$.

Simplify the following logical expression using K-Map and implement using only NAND gates:

$$
f(A,B,C,D)=\Sigma m(0,2,9,13)+\Sigma d(7,11,15)
$$
With the help of a truth table and logical expressions, realize full adder using only basic gates.
Draw the logic diagram of a 4-bit SISO shift register and write the truth table to shift the data 11001 entered from LSB to the right. Mention the number of clock cycles required to retrieve the MSB.

A $200\ \mathrm{W}$, $90\ \mathrm{kHz}$ carrier is amplitude modulated to a depth of $65\%$ by a modulating signal of $5\ \mathrm{kHz}$ frequency. Given $R_L = 1\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$. Determine the

i) Total power transmitted.
ii) Power transmitted in sideband frequencies.
iii) Bandwidth of transmitted signal.
iv) Plot the frequency spectrum of the resulting AM wave.
For the given binary data 10100110, sketch ASK, FSK and PSK Signals.

Define the sampling theorem. What is the Nyquist sampling rate of the signal

$$
x(t)=8\cos(200\pi t)+10\sin(1000\pi t)+15\cos(550\pi t).
$$
